# YESJ - Youth Empowering Service Jesuits
> YESJ is a ministry of the Andhra Jesuit Province, India, dedicated to empowering marginalized youth in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh through education, skill development, leadership formation, and community accompaniment since 2016.
